provenance.adaptation: Editorial rules 1, 3-9, 11, 12, 17 and 19. Factual accuracy overrides style. Benchmark and concealment instructions excluded. Scene rules are project-specific.

review_rules: Use review-samples.jsonl as one shared writing corpus across all categories. Randomly select one sample for rhythm, expression and approximate length; get all product content from the current photo. Do not apply category filters or preset style profiles.
No exclamatory sentences, exclamation marks or excited interjections, even when the reference contains them. Keep opinions as plain comments.

React to what you actually notice in the photo. No required opener: a personal reaction, fragment or visible detail can work. Avoid defaulting to The [detail] is/looks or any other repeated sentence frame.
Use concrete ordinary words, contractions and occasional short fragments. Vary sentence rhythm and openings across items.
One modest opinion is enough. Skip formal connectors, balanced benefit lists, long explanations and closing recommendations.
Use commas or separate sentences instead of em dashes. Lowercase, loose punctuation and minor spelling or grammar slips are acceptable; do not force mistakes or invent experiences.
Preserve uncertainty and all factual constraints. Do not imply a real customer purchase or history. Return only the requested demo review.
scene_rules: Show one ordinary moment with a small credible activity appropriate to the product, rather than a posed advertising scene.

Use existing everyday surroundings and their natural light. Preserve the absence of props; do not introduce objects, people or activities merely to make the photo feel lived-in. Avoid unrelated lifestyle stereotypes.
Keep the actual product details intact; ordinary camera imperfections must never obscure or distort it.

Use the camera character of an everyday phone snapshot: informal framing, ordinary exposure and restrained colors. Avoid cinematic grading, HDR glow, CGI surfaces and a perfectly styled advertising composition.

For furniture, preserve the original room and all existing unrelated objects. Add only the actual target product and explicitly user-requested components; keep bare surfaces and empty spaces empty. Do not add tableware, food, books, plants, people or decorations absent from the room. Do not import staging props from the product photo. Do not add wear or defects to make the product look real.
